sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.person_id, count(*)::float8 AS v FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id) a0 ON a0.person_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.person_id, max(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $4::text)) = 'number' THEN CASE WHEN abs(((e.properties -> $4::text))::numeric) <= 1e300 THEN ((e.properties -> $4::text))::float8 END END) AS v FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id) a1 ON a1.person_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.person_id, count(*)::float8 AS v FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id) a2 ON a2.person_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.person_id, max(e.occurred_at) AS v FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id) a3 ON a3.person_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.person_id, sum(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $4::text)) = 'number' THEN CASE WHEN abs(((e.properties -> $4::text))::numeric) <= 1e300 THEN ((e.properties -> $4::text))::float8 END END) AS v FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text AND e.occurred_at > $10::timestamptz AND e.occurred_at <= $9::timestamptz GROUP BY e.person_id) a4 ON a4.person_id = p.id WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND (((COALESCE((COALESCE(a0.v, 0::float8) >= $3::float8), false) OR COALESCE((a1.v > $5::float8), false) OR p.traits @> $6::jsonb) AND NOT (COALESCE((COALESCE(a2.v, 0::float8) >= $7::float8), false)) AND NOT (COALESCE((a3.v <@ tstzrange($8::timestamptz, $9::timestamptz, '(]')), false)) AND NOT (COALESCE((a4.v > $11::float8), false))))
